description: Deletes an Entity Grant for the given User or Entity.

X-FusionAuth-TenantId.description: The unique Id of the tenant used to scope this API request. Only required when there is more than one tenant and the API key is not tenant-scoped.

entityId.description: The Id of the Entity that the Entity Grant is being deleted for.

recipientEntityId.description: The Id of the Entity that the Entity Grant is for.

userId.description: The Id of the User that the Entity Grant is for.

name: deleteEntityGrantWithId
